analysis.title: The small-cap squeeze?
key_insights: Russell 2000 is trading around the major trendline that has held since May 2025, after an aggressive sell-off.
The index is below its 200-day moving average. Small caps dipped below this level in March and then bounced aggressively, and the note asks whether history will repeat.
Russell's weekly RSI has started turning higher after hitting its most oversold levels in a long time, an early sign of stabilization.
Russell is very sensitive to rising yields, and the inverse also holds. The 10-year has paused and the RUT/NDX ratio has caught some bids as rates came down.
The RUT/NDX spread just reversed from the lower part of its trend line.
Equity volatility indexes have caught a bid, but the rise in RVX (Russell 2000 volatility) has been muted compared with the sharp repricing in tech volatility.
CTAs are running aggressive shorts in their short-term models. These positions could flip into buying if small caps attract further bids, adding fuel to an upside move.

macro_indicators.interpretation: The 10-year has paused and easing yields are giving relief to small caps. Russell is very sensitive to rising yields.

risk_factors: Russell remains below its 200-day moving average.
The index is testing a trendline, and the squeeze thesis depends on it holding.
Rising yields would hurt small caps, which are very sensitive to rates.
vol_and_positioning: RVX (Russell 2000 volatility index) has risen only modestly compared with the sharp repricing in tech volatility, so small-cap volatility remains relatively contained.
CTAs are running aggressive shorts in their short-term models (source: BofA). These could quickly flip into buying if small caps attract further bids.
Weekly RSI on Russell is turning higher from its most oversold levels in a long time.

tension_points.bull_case: Russell is testing a trendline held since May 2025, weekly RSI is turning up from deeply oversold levels, yields are easing, RVX is muted, and aggressive CTA shorts could flip into buying.
tension_points.bear_case: The index is still below its 200-day moving average and is very sensitive to any renewed rise in yields.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A break below the trendline that has held since May 2025.

theme_stances.key_argument: Russell is testing a long-term trendline with momentum turning up from oversold levels, easing yields, and aggressive CTA shorts that could become buying fuel.
theme_stances.evidence: aggressive CTA shorts could quickly turn into buying fuel
